create_get_loss: create a loss function by calling get_loss with a config object specifying type as unflow
build_unflow_loss: build an unFlowLoss instance from a config object for optical flow training
run_loss_forward: run the unFlowLoss forward pass on pyramid flows and image pairs to compute photometric and smooth losses
test_loss_one_pair: test the loss_one_pair method with pyramid flows and origin images to get photometric and smooth loss components
review_loss_photomatric: review the loss_photomatric method that combines L1, SSIM, and Ternary losses with visibility masks
